scope.description: An optional direction for a user-requested simple mechanical object whose movement should remain legible. Describe the object with a few wiry, active ink lines while allowing a translucent color field to establish a separate shallow atmosphere. Let at least one line travel beyond the object's contour into open paper; do not turn that gesture into a fixed symbol or narrative.
limitations: Activate only for a user-requested simple mechanical object or device with implied or requested movement.
Preserve the requested object, material, count, controls, and action; do not add a default bird, music note, perch, trap, letter, or landscape.
Keep line and color as distinguishable carriers; the line records action or connection, while the color field builds atmosphere without filling every line-bounded area.
Retain enough object geometry for recognition; a freely moving line must not change the object's structure or function.
Keep paper visible and use only a few incidental transfer-like marks; do not imitate a specific Klee drawing or its composition.

rules.applies_when: The user requests one simple mechanical object with implied or requested movement.
rules.instruction: Use a small number of wiry, hand-drawn lines to make the requested object's structure and motion readable; let one connected line travel beyond its contour into open space rather than closing every form.
rules.observable: The object remains identifiable while at least one active line has a clear path into negative space that is not simply a copied outer contour.
rules.reject_when: The line becomes a dense blueprint, an unrelated decorative squiggle, or changes the mechanism's user-specified structure.
rules.avoid: bird forms, music-note marks, copied wire perch, and rigid CAD edges

rules.applies_when: The user requests a stylized mechanical study on a paper-like support.
rules.instruction: Set one translucent, irregular color field behind or across part of the mechanism; allow it to establish shallow atmosphere independently from the ink line and leave some paper unpainted.
rules.observable: A viewer can distinguish line-drawn structure from the larger soft-edged color field; the color does not simply fill every mechanical contour.
rules.reject_when: Color becomes uniform object fill, a full-bleed background, or photographic volumetric shading.
rules.avoid: all-over gradient, enclosing frame, and color-coded technical diagram

rules.applies_when: The user allows a handmade drawing surface.
rules.instruction: Keep the paper visibly present and use only a few faint, irregular transfer-like smudges near the drawn mechanism; let these marks register the support without becoming extra objects or symbols.
rules.observable: Empty paper remains an active part of the composition, with incidental marks subordinate to the requested object and color field.
rules.reject_when: Smudges obscure object details, form an all-over distressed texture, or read as added symbols or text.
rules.avoid: dirt, grunge overlays, deliberate handwriting, and copied transfer artifacts
